mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cps_order_collection_retry (dedupe_key, platform, task_type, window_from, window_to, page_cursor, error_code) VALUES (#{dedupeKey}, #{platform}, #{taskType}, #{windowFrom}, #{windowTo}, #{pageCursor}, #{errorCode}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM cps_order_collection_retry WHERE (status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (status = 'LEASED' AND lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE cps_order_collection_retry SET status = 'LEASED', lease_token = #{token}, lease_until = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{leaseSeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), attempts = attempts + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND ((status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (status = 'LEASED' AND lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cps_order_collection_retry WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'LEASED' AND lease_token = #{token}
mapper.update: UPDATE cps_order_collection_retry SET status = 'DONE', lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'LEASED' AND lease_token = #{token} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE cps_order_collection_retry SET status = 'PENDING', lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, error_code = #{errorCode}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'LEASED' AND lease_token = #{token} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
